facts.fact: CENI president Prosper Ntahorwamiye said posting or publishing the electoral lists is already a step in the register audit, as it lets citizens and stakeholders carry out checks (reported by SOS Medias Burundi).
CENI president said a voter who loses their card keeps the right to vote provided they are registered in the electoral database (reported by SOS Medias Burundi).

slug: 2025-05-16 Burundi - CENI extends voter registration card collection by one day
note: Covers card collection and coercion around registration; states nothing on a digital roll, checking the roll, or linkage to ID.
The electoral commission says the register is not fully digitalised but gives no status of a digital roll.

facts.fact: The electoral commission CENI president Prosper Ntahorwamiye announced on 15 October 2024 that anyone enrolling as a voter in the 22-31 October 2024 enrolment must present a valid national identity card.

note: Document states nothing on a voters' roll.
